errors.text_span: Die horizontalen Achsen sind mit den Namen der 16 Bundesländer, nämlich Nordrhein-Westfalen, Niedersachsen, Schleswig-Holstein, Bayern, Deutschland, Sachsen-Anhalt, Baden-Württemberg, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Rheinland-Pfalz, Hessen, Sachsen, Brandenburg, Thüringen, Saarland, versehen.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the categories (Bundesländer) are on the horizontal axes. In this horizontal bar chart, the categories are on the vertical axis, and the values are on the single horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse stellt die Pachtpreise in Euro pro Hektar (Euro/ha) dar
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the lease prices are on the vertical axis. The prices are shown on the horizontal axis.
The description states there are 16 federal states shown, but the chart displays only 14 categories (13 states plus 'Deutschland').
The description includes 'Deutschland' in a list of 'Bundesländer' (federal states). In the context of the chart, 'Deutschland' represents the national average, not a federal state.
The description states the tick interval on the value axis is 100, but the axis shows ticks at 0, 500, and 1,000, indicating an interval of 500.
The description claims all bars are the same color, but the bar for 'Deutschland' is dark blue to highlight it against the other light blue bars.
